responsibleApplicationExpressions.kind: dynamic filesystem paths analyzed as broad asset globs

whyDefaultHeapFailed: NFT's glob analysis accumulates matches from broad dynamic filesystem expressions over the multi-million-file runtime tree. V8 reached its approximately 4 GiB old-space ceiling while resolving an asynchronous readdir result.

eightGiBExperiment.conclusion: The default heap is not the sole blocker; doubling old space only lets the same expansion consume more memory.

nextScopeDefectEvidence.outputFileTracingExcludesAppliedBy: collect-build-traces.js after the entrypoint NFT phase
nextScopeDefectEvidence.conclusion: The documented final-trace exclusions do not protect the earlier TraceEntryPointsPlugin NFT scan that OOMs.

runtimeDataInFinalBundle: not established; the build dies before trace assets/final bundle are produced, while configured later exclusions are intended to remove these paths

minimumRepair.reason: The only allowed full build disproved the 8 GiB-only repair. Changing trace scope or application path analyzability now would require a new qualified build, which is outside the one-build limit and must not be guessed.
